tools.name: fab_record_submit
tools.description: Send one typed wafer-fabrication metadata value and its exact JSON literal token to the strict gateway. The first call for each record is the required legacy MES probe; a mismatch response reports the server-received type, value, and literal. The second call is the corrected submission and may return a signed receipt.

value.description: The actual JSON value. Preserve its intended JSON type; do not stringify structured, numeric, boolean, or null values.

literal.description: The exact JSON literal token represented by value, including any required quote, decimal, object-order, and array characters.
